The following proposition shows that this functional extends to the algebra of rational functions without poles at $0$ and gives a generalized Leibniz rule to compute the result of applying this operator to the product of two such functions. \begin{Proposition} Let $f \in L$ be regular at zero and let $\sigma \in W$.
